rule: Start context must include party_id, character_id, region_id, place_id, location_id, canonical_g4_node_id or explicit party_location_id, g4_type_id, season, time and cause.
G4 type must match a G5 template. Category fallback is allowed only with needs_review validation issue; no generic anchors.
G5 materialization must not create new G1-G4 nodes or change canonical graph.
Every minilocation, scene anchor and G5 edge must belong to the selected G4 location.
Required anchor categories from the matched template must be covered or explicitly waived by an audit issue.
No anchor may match forbidden anchor types: magic, modern object, quest marker, ownerless treasure, new G4 node.
Every significant anchor must have visibility, access, ownership/control, witness and risk fields.
Items can only be created with causal reason and allowed place/profile category; player request alone is insufficient.
G5 edge base_time_minutes must be between 0 and 5 unless explicitly blocked as impossible.
party_current_position must include region_id, place_id, location_id, minilocation_id, anchor_id and current_node_id.
Visible package must not include hidden motives, hidden items, exact future events, objective map or internal calculations.
Commit is blocked if any prior blocking validation failed.
DB writes must be atomic; partial G5 scene without current_position is invalid.
Draft/needs_review source status is preserved; source confidence cannot be upgraded by materialization.
